name: ODC_TRANS_PARKINGRESTRICTIONS_L_Publish
title: Denver Parking Restrictions
description: DOTI routinely monitors and collects parking restrictions and occupancy data that is used for planning efforts. The data help DOTI make informed decisions about where to implement changes to accommodate the citizens of Denver as best as possible.
snippet: The parking restrictions data is intended to show all curbside restrictions at different points of the day. This will include no parking areas, loading zones, hourly parking, among others. The data also includes occupancy data as it is refreshed by DOTI and is used for parking planning activities.
